data.exact_reserve_text: In 2018, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves (2017:deficit GBP 1.8m).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 5.443m on prior year reserves (2016 and older), calculated from the claims development triangle. This is consistent with the reported net deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves. The report attributes this to the inherent uncertainty in claims estimation and initial reserves not always being in surplus.
raw_causal_phrases: an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves
uncertainty inherent in the claims estimation process, initial reserves may not always be in a surplus
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2016 and older. The narrative text explicitly states a net deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves, which is a net strengthening, but the gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
